name: ai-voice-calling-agent
description: Modular AI voice calling MVP — campaigns, contacts, scripted outbound calls

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@voice/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@voice/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@voice/shared && npm run build --workspace=@voice/api && npm run build --workspace=@voice/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@voice/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@voice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
